chunks: My father (may Allah have mercy on him) narrated to me from Sa'd ibn Abdillah, from Ali ibn Isma'il ibn Isa, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that al-Husayn ibn Ali (peace be upon him) said to his companions on the day they were killed: 'I testify that permission has been granted for your killing, so fear Allah and be patient.' Also narrated to me is Muhammad ibn Ja'far al-Razzaz, from his uncle Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from Ali ibn al-Nu'man, from al-Husayn ibn Abi al-'Ala', similarly.
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Husayn say to his companions on the day of martyrdom?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the conscious acceptance of martyrdom by Imam al-Husayn (a.s.) and his companions, framing their death not as a defeat but as a divinely ordained destiny. It underscores the Shia theological emphasis on *sabr* (patient endurance) as an active spiritual struggle during the culmination of the Ahl al-Bayt's sacrifice. The text serves as a foundational reference for the ritual and spiritual commemoration of the Ahl al-Bayt's suffering.
